name: Womblex
description: Extracts text, tables and forms from government document releases (scanned, redacted and mixed PDFs, DOCX, spreadsheets, images), chunks it and prepares it for semantic analysis. Provisional: describes the /v1 service API; no A2A endpoint is served.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: A service token from the client registry (WOMBLEX_API_CLIENTS).

skills.name: Collections
skills.description: The `collections` operations of the /v1 API: List Collections (`GET /v1/collections`); Get Collection (`GET /v1/collections/{name}`); Add To Collection (`POST /v1/collections/{name}/add`); Rerun Collection (`POST /v1/collections/{name}/rerun`).

skills.name: Config
skills.description: The `config` operations of the /v1 API: Get Stages (`GET /v1/stages`); Get Schema (`GET /v1/config/schema`); Validate (`POST /v1/config/validate`); To Yaml (`POST /v1/config/yaml`).

skills.name: Hooks
skills.description: The `hooks` operations of the /v1 API: List Events (`GET /v1/workflows/{workflow}/inbound-events`).

skills.name: Presets
skills.description: The `presets` operations of the /v1 API: List Presets (`GET /v1/presets`); Save Preset (`POST /v1/presets`); Get Preset (`GET /v1/presets/{name}`); Delete Preset (`DELETE /v1/presets/{name}`).

skills.name: Runs
skills.description: The `runs` operations of the /v1 API: Get Queue (`GET /v1/queue`); List Stored Runs (`GET /v1/store/runs`); Get Stage Presence (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/stages/{stage}`); Get Audit (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/audit`); Get Document Detail (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/documents/{source_hash}/detail`); List Logs (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/logs`); Read Log (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/logs/{name}`); Get Progress (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/progress`); List Runs (`GET /v1/runs`); Submit Run (`POST /v1/runs`); Get Run (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}`); Get Manifest (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/manifest`); Get Files (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/files`); Get Document Text (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/documents/{source_hash}/text`); Get Metrics (`GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/metrics`).

skills.name: Uploads
skills.description: The `uploads` operations of the /v1 API: Preview Ingest (`GET /v1/ingest`); Upload (`POST /v1/uploads`).
